cards.ex: I get along with my colleagues really well.
cards.exUz: Men hamkasblarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq, do'stona aloqada bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: She's a real people person, everyone loves her.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy odamshil, hamma uni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan oson aloqa qila oladigan, do'stona inson.

cards.ex: Despite his success, he's still very down to earth.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatiga qaramay, u hali ham juda oddiy.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, samimiy va takabbur bo'lmagan inson.

cards.ex: I picked up some Spanish while I was in Mexico.
cards.exUz: Men Meksikada bo'lganimda ozgina ispan tilini o'rgandim.

cards.ex: It took me a while to fit in at my new school.
cards.exUz: Yangi maktabimga moslashish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a night owl.
cards.exUz: Men bir oz tungi qushman.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir sifatga ega bo'lgan insonni tasvirlash.

cards.ex: I'm looking forward to getting to know you better.
cards.exUz: Siz bilan yaxshiroq tanishishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

cards.ex: First impressions are important, so dress nicely.
cards.exUz: Birinchi taassurot muhim, shuning uchun chiroyli kiyining.
cards.uzDef: Birov haqida birinchi ko'rishda olingan fikr.

cards.ex: Helping others is what makes me tick.
cards.exUz: Boshqalarga yordam berish meni ilhomlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Meni nima ruhlantiradi, qiziqtiradi yoki motivatsiya beradi.

cards.ex: I'm really into photography these days.
cards.exUz: Men hozirgi kunda fotografiyaga juda qiziqaman.

cards.ex: I'm a big fan of jazz music.
cards.exUz: Men jazz musiqasining ashaddiy muxlisiman.

cards.ex: I draw the line at lying; I can't tolerate it.
cards.exUz: Men yolg'onga chegara qo'yaman; Men bunga toqat qilolmayman.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile to help his friends.
cards.exUz: U doim do'stlariga yordam berish uchun astoydil harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: I really look up to my older sister; she's so successful.
cards.exUz: Men katta opamni juda hurmat qilaman; u juda muvaffaqiyatli.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hurmat qilmoq va undan o'rnak olmoq.

cards.ex: Loud chewing really gets on my nerves.
cards.exUz: Balad ovozda chaynash menga haqiqatan ham asabga tegadi.

cards.ex: My English is a work in progress, I'm still learning.
cards.exUz: Mening ingliz tilim ish jarayonida, men hali ham o'rganayapman.

cards.ex: Growing up in the countryside was wonderful.
cards.exUz: Qishloqda ulg'ayish ajoyib edi.

cards.ex: I always turn to my best friend when I have a problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoim bo'lganda doim eng yaxshi do'stimga murojaat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Yordam yoki maslahat uchun kimga murojaat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm majoring in computer science at university.
cards.exUz: Men universitetda kompyuter fanlari bo'yicha mutaxassislik qilaman.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to the weekend.
cards.exUz: Men haqiqatan ham dam olish kunlarini kutmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishini intiqlik bilan kutmoq.

cards.ex: Opera isn't really my cup of tea.
cards.exUz: Opera men uchun emas (mening didim emas).
cards.uzDef: Menga yoqadigan narsa, meni qiziqtiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm an early bird, I love waking up early.
cards.exUz: Men erta turuvchiman, erta uyg'onishni yaxshi ko'raman.

cards.ex: She's a night owl, she works best late at night.
cards.exUz: U tungi qush, u kechasi yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

cards.ex: Well, I made a mistake, but live and learn!
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, men xato qildim, lekin yashab o'rganamiz!

cards.ex: He's always the life of the party.
cards.exUz: U har doim kechaning yulduzi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday partiyani yanada qiziqarli qiladigan inson.

cards.ex: A good joke can break the ice.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi hazil muzni eritishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I built my business from scratch.
cards.exUz: Men biznesimni noldan qurdim.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu loyihani boshlaylik.

cards.ex: The hospital is open around the clock.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona kechayu kunduz ochiq.
